specification.gate: All 27 no-ranking 4,000-iteration preflights complete before cold count preparation or any independent ranking. Cold full 8x8 counts match both the pinned PR131 physical report and independent ordered-board numeric-rule replay. Every case has three timed remap+provenance+prepared-solve+complete-wrapper-JSON calls, independent physical count/policy replay, exact work-budget parity, and zero warm rank calls. Each full 8x8 global-image result, after inverse mapping board and hand labels and removing only equity_preparation, must reproduce the pinned PR131 complete policy payload hash. Target is independent NashConv plus 1e-9 <= 0.005 chips. Misses and expected resource rejections are preserved; there is no fallback.
specification.model_limits: Heads-up fixed flop, finite flop betting and forced hidden turn/river checkdown. Suit remaps transfer only exact 4-suit global images of a source board plus ordered OOP/IP private pair. No later-street betting, preflop solving, rake, multiway play or unrestricted NLHE.
specification.provenance_note: Independently developed exact suit-image benchmark. Production remap provenance is checked by separately applied 4-suit maps and a locally spelled 52-card deck bijection, including each source/target 45-card remaining deck. Independent best-five numeric-rule policy replay is the accuracy oracle. No external code or dependencies are used.

allocation.includes: Suit remap, provenance, prepared solve and wrapper JSON serialization.
allocation.excludes: Cached source table, cold preparation, independent oracle, process RSS.

timing_scope: Three complete 4,000-iteration calls per case; each timed call includes suit remap, provenance generation, prepared solve and JSON serialization of result plus provenance. Independent numeric-rule oracle and replay are outside timing.
allocation_scope: Separate Python tracemalloc call for first 8x8 image includes suit remap, provenance, solve and JSON; excludes source table/cold preparation, oracle and process RSS.
accuracy_scope: Independent ordered future board and best-five numeric-rule replay with own-hand information-set best responses. Whole eight-hand source-game images must inverse-map to the pinned PR131 result payload hash. Preserve misses; no fallback.
